== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Rebel Scout (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[Rebel Scout (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]]. The whole of the disc card and the whole of the 2018 E card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
